papers.title: AgentHarm: A Benchmark for Measuring Harmfulness of LLM Agents
papers.relation: benchmark definition (tasks, harm score, refusal judge); reviewed by the Zenodo record. Its result tables (Fig. 3, Table 9 public test, Table 10 private test) evaluate 15 API/Llama models, none of the three Ollama models of this corpus, so no paper number is an L2 reference for this corpus Fact-check 2026-10-14: the paper's Table 1 gives a public test set of 264 behaviours (44 validation, 132 private, 440 total), while the released HF test_public split has 176 harmful, 176 harmless_benign and 44 chat rows (datasets-server size API, https://datasets-server.huggingface.co/size?dataset=ai-safety-institute/AgentHarm). The 176 per arm therefore comes from the released dataset, not from the paper's split sizes (lead L-15). Qwen3 (2025-04-29) and gpt-oss (2025-08) postdate v3 (2025-04-18), so they cannot be in any version's tables.
papers.versions: v1 2024-10-11 (489 KB), v2 2024-10-14 (489 KB), v3 2025-04-18 (518 KB, 'Accepted at ICLR 2025'); abstract counts (110 tasks, 440 augmented, 11 categories) identical in v1 and v3; table-level diff not done (models not in this corpus). https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.09024v1

discrepancy_leads: L-01 Producer version: the header names inspect_ai 0.3.247.dev69+g53c1fa98b, a dev build 132 commits before the 0.3.247 release; the survey README says v0.3.247 (documentation-mismatch, cosmetic).

L-02 Scorer version 2-B: the six logs were scored by inspect_evals 2dd469a (AgentHarm 2-B); fixes 3-B..8-B and #2146 came later, so the README numbers are 2-B semantics and differ from what the upstream-recommended 6-B (or 8-B) would report on the same transcripts.

L-03 #2107: the 2-B refusal judge only reads assistant text, so reasoning-only assistant messages (qwen3:14b, gpt-oss) are never judged; the refusal rates of the reasoning models are measured on less text than qwen3-coder's.
L-04 #2108: 2-B graders credit tool calls that never executed or errored; samples with tool errors or with calls lost at the message limit can carry score > 0 for unexecuted actions.
L-05 #2101: the benign meeting-location grading check cannot pass at 2-B, so affected benign samples are capped below 1.0 and avg_full_score is depressed for every model.
L-06 #2146: at 2-B avg_full_score skips samples whose score is a JSON integer (from numerator and denominator); a recomputation over all samples can differ from the header value.

L-07 #2439: benign read_file, edit_txt and convert_pdf_to_text resolve bundled content relative to the working directory, and run_full_benchmark.sh runs from the inspect_evals checkout root; unless Inspect changes directory for package tasks, these benign tool calls returned file-not-found errors, depressing benign scores (direction undetermined before the data check).

L-08 #2212 / #2312: judge API errors and unparseable judge replies become 'not refused'; substring parsing can turn a 'No' verdict into a refusal. The self-judging qwen3:14b judge makes this harder to bound; only the error string in refusal_explanations is countable.
L-09 qwen3:14b benign refusal: README 0.063 vs header 0.062 (our investigation) for 11/176 = 0.0625: rounding only.
L-10 Member count: 6 x 286 members (verify report) = 1,716 vs 1,691 members.jsonl rows (import report): 25 unaccounted (directory entries or per-log journal differences).

L-11 E2-b5 catalogue entries (inspect max_tokens stops 23, text-encoded tool calls 12) are not in src/agentprov/adapters/inspect/artefacts.toml at 065b0d36 (9 ids, none of them): the safety net should still report them as unclassified.

L-12 The header records the AgentHarm dataset location as a path in the author's home directory (verify report 2.5): an account path in raw; it must not reach AER/SEM/PROV (no redact table in the profile; D-182 scan found none in harness fields).

L-13 Judge configuration differs from the agent's: judge model events carry no seed and no max_tokens (verify report 1 item 1); the README says the eval hardcodes temperature 0 and seed 0 for the agent only.
L-14 Zenodo v1.0.0 vs v1.0.1 artifact.zip differ by 2 bytes; agentharm/results sizes identical to git in v1.0.1 (v1.0.0 not compared).

L-15 Paper vs released data (context, not a defect of this corpus): AgentHarm paper Table 1 states a 264-behaviour public test set; the released HF test_public has 176 harmful + 176 benign rows. Our 176-per-arm expectation rests on the released split, the survey README and the registry, not on the paper. Added by fact-check 2026-10-14.
